resources.string: Tap a device to type on it. Long-press to remove it.
No paired devices yet. Tap Pair device and scan the QR code on a smart board.
Remove this device from your list? To use it again you will need to scan its QR code.
Other devices see this name when you pair or connect.
That is this device\'s own code. Scan it with your phone instead.
The camera is needed to scan the QR code on the board.
Camera access is turned off for Phone Keyboard. Allow it in the app settings to scan a board\'s QR code.
Use this device as a smart board
The board keeps its normal keyboard. When a paired phone connects, Phone Keyboard takes over, and when the phone stops (no heartbeat for a few seconds) the normal keyboard comes back.
Keyboard: enabled. It switches in when a phone connects.
Switching: not allowed yet. In step 3, turn on \"Phone Keyboard\" under Accessibility. Until then you choose Phone Keyboard from the notification.
Switching: this Android version needs a one-time adb command for automatic switching (see README). Until then you choose Phone Keyboard from the notification.
Lets Phone Keyboard switch this board to the phone keyboard when a paired phone connects, and back to the normal keyboard when it leaves. It does not read the screen or anything you type.
Switching: needs a one-time adb command (see README) in this board-lite version. Until then you choose Phone Keyboard from the notification when a phone connects.
This is the board app. Scan the code with the phone app instead.
%1$s connected: tap to switch to Phone Keyboard
Keyboard: not enabled on this device
Background: limited by battery optimization (tap step 2)
Scan this with Pair device on your phone. Paired phones can connect any time without it.
Unpair removes this phone: it will need the QR code again.
On your phone: Phone Keyboard → Pair device, and scan this. Paired phones just tap this board in their list.
